mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (content, post_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{content}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, u.username, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN member u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR c.id < #{cursor}) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
